title: Good Variety
text: Good Variety. This includes a good variety of storage containers. I like the clear bins a lot. They're just what I needed. There are also a couple of food leftovers containers with lids. The product description says that the items are not dishwasher friendly. My instinct with cleaning the bins is to hand wash. But with the storage containers I assumed that they would be okay on the top rack of the dishwasher. Well, they're not. They came out all warped. Oh well..... I liked the bins better anyway.

product_metadata.title: HERKKA Plastic Storage Organizer Container Bin for Bathroom, Pantry, Kitchen Cabinet, Fridge, Office and Home Organization - 6 pack - 12.2 inch - Clear
features: PERFECT SIZE: Set of 6, each bin measures Approx. 12.2” L × 7.9” W × 3.6” H. Great for storing fruits, vegetables yogurts, canned goods, food packets, cheese, meat in your fridge or freezer, also good for storing dry goods in the pantry such as flavors, baking supplies, snack bags, boxed foods. Maximize storage space and ideal for refrigerator, freezer, cabinets, cupboards, pantry shelves or inside drawers.

PREMIUM & HEALTHY MATERIAL: These fridge and freezer organizer Bins are made of durable high quality food grade BPA Free shatter-resistant plastic. They are strong enough to last for long. Easy to care! Just wash with mild soapy water. Do not place in dishwasher.

SPACE SAVING: Using them side by side to keep items organized and easy to find, helps for maximize your space, and ideal for refrigerator, freezer, cabinets, cupboards, pantry shelves or inside drawers. Let to make organizing and everyday living a little easier.

CLEAR VIEW: With transparent design, you can easily find what you want with clear view, cuts time from looking around. The built-in and easy-grip side handles make it easy to carry and easy to transport contents. Also, it has interior non slip texture, you are no need to worry about slipping off.

MULTI-USE: These versatile storage bins can be used in any room of the home - use them in kitchens, toy room, craft rooms, offices, laundry/utility rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms, garages, playroom and more; light weight and easy to transport, these are great in apartments, dorm rooms, RVs and campers.
